decisions.why: The division's own categories ('Burns, Plastics & Skin', 'Biosynthetic Allograft Substitute') and its example products are genuine advanced wound/burn care devices: RECELL GO and RECELL System (AVITA Medical's autologous cell harvesting devices, FDA-labelled for thermal burn wounds and full-thickness skin defects) and Epiprotect (a biosynthetic cellulose dressing for burns, published in UK clinical burns literature) are both skin-substitute/advanced-dressing technology, matching the precedent already set for other suppliers' skin-substitute and advanced-dressing lines (e.g. HC21 (UK) Ltd's Collagen Dressings, Electro Spyres Healthcare's SkinResQ range) -> wound:adv.
